# DoubleZero Data

> Public telemetry and analytics for the DoubleZero network. DoubleZero is a protocol for building and operating high-performance, permissionless networks. This site publishes the network's operational data: device and link health, path latency, topology, traffic, shreds delivery, outages, and validator stake distribution.

All data on this site is public. No authentication is required to read it. Requests are rate limited per IP.

## Query this data directly

Agents should use the Model Context Protocol server rather than scraping the web UI. It exposes the underlying databases directly.

- [MCP endpoint](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP transport. No authentication.
- [Server card](https://data.doublezero.xyz/.well-known/mcp.json): Machine-readable server description.
- [Setup guide](https://data.doublezero.xyz/docs/mcp): How to connect a client.

Tools:

- `get_schema`: Table and column definitions. Call this first. Do not guess table or column names.
- `execute_sql`: Read-only SQL against ClickHouse. Telemetry, latency, traffic, shreds, stake, and status.
- `execute_cypher`: Read-only Cypher against Neo4j. Topology, path finding, reachability, and metro-to-metro latency. Available on mainnet-beta only.
- `read_docs`: DoubleZero documentation for conceptual and setup questions.

Use `execute_cypher` for path and reachability questions. SQL holds only directly connected pairs, so multi-hop paths must come from the graph.

## HTTP API

Read-only JSON. Select an environment with the `X-DZ-Env` header: `mainnet-beta` (default), `testnet`, or `devnet`.

- [Catalog](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/catalog): Data catalog.
- [Status](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/status): Current network status.
- [Stats](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/stats): Summary statistics.
- [Devices](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/dz/devices): Network devices.
- [Links](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/dz/links): Network links.
- [Timeline](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/timeline): Network event timeline.
- [Config](https://data.doublezero.xyz/api/config): Environment and feature flags.

## Network health

- [Network Status](https://data.doublezero.xyz/status): Device, link, and metro health.
- [Link Incidents](https://data.doublezero.xyz/ops/incidents/links): Link incident history.
- [Device Incidents](https://data.doublezero.xyz/ops/incidents/devices): Device incident history.
- [Methodology](https://data.doublezero.xyz/status/methodology): How these measurements are taken.
- [Timeline](https://data.doublezero.xyz/timeline): Network event timeline.

## Topology and performance

- [Topology Map](https://data.doublezero.xyz/topology/map): Live map of the network.
- [Topology Globe](https://data.doublezero.xyz/topology/globe): Globe view.
- [Path Calculator](https://data.doublezero.xyz/topology/path-calculator): Latency between any two points.
- [Redundancy](https://data.doublezero.xyz/topology/redundancy): Redundancy analysis.
- [Metro Connectivity](https://data.doublezero.xyz/topology/metro-connectivity): Connectivity between metros.
- [DoubleZero vs Internet](https://data.doublezero.xyz/performance/dz-vs-internet): Latency compared to the public internet.
- [Path Latency](https://data.doublezero.xyz/performance/path-latency): Measured path latency.
- [Traffic](https://data.doublezero.xyz/traffic/overview): Network traffic.

## Shreds

- [Shreds Scoreboard](https://data.doublezero.xyz/dz/shreds/scoreboard): Live shreds delivery scoreboard.
- [Publishers](https://data.doublezero.xyz/dz/shreds/publishers): Validators publishing shreds, and whether a given validator is publishing.
- [Subscribers](https://data.doublezero.xyz/dz/shreds/subscribers): Shreds subscribers.
- [Activity](https://data.doublezero.xyz/dz/shreds/activity): Shreds activity over time.
- [Economics](https://data.doublezero.xyz/dz/shreds/economics): Shreds economics.
- [Rewards](https://data.doublezero.xyz/dz/shreds/rewards): Shreds rewards.
